definition: SPTAN1 (spectrin alpha, non-erythrocytic 1) encodes alpha-II spectrin (alphaII-spectrin). Heterozygous mutations in SPTAN1 are causal for autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuronopathy-11 (HMND11; OMIM #620528), a condition characterized by length-dependent axonal degeneration of lower motor neurons with variable penetrance and juvenile or adult onset, in the absence of significant sensory neuron involvement.

source.title: Nonsense mutations in alpha-II spectrin in three families with juvenile onset hereditary motor neuropathy
source.quote: We identified patients with heterozygous nonsense mutations in the αII-spectrin gene, SPTAN1, in three separate dominant hereditary motor neuropathy families via next-generation sequencing.
